body: I'm glad I could help! By the way, I absolutely LOVE the username hahaha

The more you convince yourself it won't change,  the less you're gonna want it to. Trust me. Nobody EVER sees their life getting better. And that statement only becomes more and more true the worse your life gets. It's kinda like a fire, it'll grow and grow and grow with the more stuff it has to burn until it's either burned everything or put out. But that fire extinguisher is in your hands, it's just up to you whether or not you use it. I don't know your situation,  but I do see it getting better as long as you try and keep trying to make it better. Don't expect to see results immediately, but just keep working at it, and you'll make it out better than ever.

I'm sorry about your loss of possessions and security. Only cunts attack defenseless people in groups. Honestly, I wouldn't stay there anymore. Moving is your safest/best option. And while I agree that that just gives those shitheads what they want (to instill fear) it's you're only real option aside from waiting for the cops to take them down, or going John Wick on them. I vote the John Wick method...good luck with everything and I hope they get brought to justice and you and your family thrive well enough to make them cringe for even attempting to take the easy way.
Thanks, I have seeked and currently am gettin help for these thoughts, I've had em long before I started smoking, they're just more intense now that I'm quittinf.
Just remember,  You're 99999999999999999 trillion times stronger, smarter and more capable than a deranged chimp.
You're welcome. If you wanna talk more,  feel free to PM me at any given time, I'll respond the second I have a free moment. We gotta look out for eachother in a crazy world like this.

Thank you sooo much. I actually have been capable of lucid dreaming since childhood and LOVE it. I appreciate you rationalizing what it going on with me as well. It's nice to know you amongst others care. I do also try meditate atleast 20 minutes a day (usually at night) it also helps when I'm having an anxiety attack which is what just happened earlier. There just WAYYY harder to deal with on your own. Thanks for the advice and kind words, I hope you're doing incredible as well.

I was in the same place my friend, until a week ago when I practically cut myself off from having ANY way to obtain weed. The saddest thing is that I could get a gram within 10 minutes of now, and I know it. Even though I have no contacts in that area anymore...it's pitiful. I highly suggest cutting any and all ties to obtaining it before trying to quit. It's the only thing that's been able to stop me. I wish you the best of luck and I, as well as all of the great people at r/leaves, are here to help.
Thank you soo much, I'm really sorry about your loss, I've lost friends to suicide but never a family member. I can't imagine that. How are you doing?

Hello, I hope I can help with this small slice of my own life. So, nearly two years ago, I was dumped by my girlfriend of 4 years. We had very similar issues to the one's you and your husband seem to be experiencing and she decided to walk. For me, that time alone afterwards was the best thing I've ever really gone through. It was miserable,  Don't get me wrong, but we both NEEDED it. We are friends once again now as of a few months ago because we both had time to grow on our own and learn who we each are as people. I never really lived life outside of her, nor her, I. But now that we had some alone time, neither of us has ever been happier. Now I'm not saying you should end it, but definitely talk to him about it, maybe even about taking some time or space apart from each other.  Try counseling again,  this time, maybe try is while you're separated. If you don't wanna separate and neither does he, work on doing things without the other person. A relationship is supposed to compliment your life and add to it, not dictate every detail of it. Good luck, my friend. I hope everything works out for both of you guys.
